title: I enjoyed every moment of...
text: I enjoyed every moment of this sunset cruise. Every staff that we encountered was friendly and wanted to make our experience special.  The views were amazing and the food was delicious 😋 I will definitely do this again. Thank you for a great evening
author: Ike_L

title: Seas the day
text: Nice small group making it feel like an intimate setting. We really enjoyed the tapas, music and the free flowing cava throughout the excursion. Our skipper, Luis was very pleasant and created a laid back relaxing atmosphere.. The weather was beautiful and even gave us the choice to ride on the open sea, which was choppy or sail along the coast, which we chose instead, as the water was much calmer. Our journey lasted nearly 2 hours and it definitely was a highlight of our stay in beautiful Barcelona!
author: Rose_B

title: Five Star Sunset 🌅
text:
⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

Such a fantastic sunset cruise in Barcelona! The views were beautiful, the cava was flowing, and the pintxos were delicious. Our captain was excellent—friendly, knowledgeable, and made the whole experience relaxed and fun. A perfect way to spend an evening on the water in Barcelona. Highly recommend!
author: Vanessa_D

title: Great short escape from BCN
text: Great team that took care of us while on board. Had a great time and a nice cruise - seeing port veil from waterside at night was great! Absolutely recommended doing this with Sailing Experience Barcelona!
author: Joerg_R

text: It was great easy to find fantastic customer service absolutely recommended

title: Sunset in Barcelona
text: It was a great experience from start to finish. The Tapas was amazing as was the hospitality. The tour felt very intimate which is what we wanted. Great value for money.
author: Julie_O

title: A++ romantic and beautiful
text:
What an amazing experience. My wife and I went for pur honeymoon 1st day un Barcelona and couldn't of started our trip any better. 
Live guitar was an amazing touch to beautiful sights of Barcelona from the water.
author: Kody_C

title: Our captain Luigi was...
text: Our captain Luigi was wonderful and very entertaining with his fun sense of humor throughout the tour.  There were 10 total in our group.    Tapas was good, drinks flowed and he was very accommodating. Also very knowledgeable and gave us history of the coastal area.  Those who think they may feel sea sick, myself and one of our friends were on the fence ... she took a dramamine, I did not, but we both did fine.  Having something in your stomach I think helps.  Sunset was absolutely beautiful and with the music Luigi played it was so relaxing and we just took it all in.  Would highly recommend!
author: R_C

title: Mediterranean delight
text: It was a perfect evening — weatherwise, fellow passengers, ambience, and captain.  The classical guitar made for a wonderful addition.
author: MaryJo_A

title: Best sailing experience for sure in Barcelona
text: It was very good the captain Joel was very nice we had a great time on the sail boat the food or the tapas were only 3 per person very little and the drinks only 3 but the trip is a must go thank you
